notes.title: More Bugs Smashed!
notes.notes:
[b]Hi all furry lovers![/b]

Thank you so much for your amazing support. It truly means a lot to me, and of course, to the wonderful girls from the game: Lisa, Trisha, and Felicity, who are all very grateful too!

I'm continuing to polish the game and fix any bugs that show up. Here’s what’s been improved in the latest patch:

- 🛠️ Fixed the grassmower noise.
- ✅ Now, if a girl is outside her room, talking to her will immediately complete the[b] “Talk to the Girl” [/b]task.
- 🔐 Room locks no longer reappear after loading a saved game.
- ✋ The big hand in the office room has been slightly reduced in size to feel less intrusive.
- 💬 After loading a save, the [b]“first meeting”[/b] conversation with each girl will no longer repeat.
- 🚪 Girls will stay in their cells more often now, making it easier to find and talk to them.
- 🖥️ A bug where the game window would change resolution and freeze has hopefully been fixed. If this still happens on your screen, please let me know!


[i][b]If you have a moment, please consider leaving a short review here on Steam.
It doesn’t have to be long, even just a few words can make a big difference and help more players discover the game. Your support really means the world to me![/b][/i]


Thanks again for playing and for your feedback, it helps make the game better for everyone 💖
Stay wild!

Red Sasori 🐾

notes.title: Furry Novel Discord
notes.notes:
🎉 Join Us on Discord! 🎉

Hello everyone! We’re thrilled to announce that our official Discord server is now live and ready for you to join! 🎊

Whether you’re looking to share your experiences, ask questions, give feedback, or just chat with fellow fans and us, the creators, this is the perfect place. Here’s what you can look forward to in our Discord:

💬 Real-Time Chats – Connect with other players and be part of the community.
🖌️ Fan Art and Creativity – Share your favorite Furry images.
🛠️ Support and Help – Get quick answers to your questions about the game.
✨ Exclusive Announcements and Previews – Be the first to know about upcoming updates and special events!

Click the link below to join us, and let’s build an amazing community together! 🚀

[url=https://discord.gg/YnetmnmnFE]Furry Novel Discord![/url]

Looking forward to seeing you there! Thank you all for your continued support! 🥂
